verdict.rationale: MoonPay's SDK exposes a delete-payment-method call ('remove a stored payment method — for example, when a customer asks to forget a card'), showing some user-initiated data deletion capability, but there is no documentation of broader retention policies, full account/KYC data deletion, or export controls. missing for 10: documented data retention policy, full account/KYC data deletion mechanism, user-facing controls beyond card removal, independent verification of deletion behavior.
